mapper.select: SELECT t.owner_id,t.id AS task_id,t.current_attempt_id AS attempt_id, e.session_id,e.question_id,e.answer_id,OCTET_LENGTH(t.candidate_json) AS report_bytes FROM ai_task t JOIN ai_evaluation e ON e.owner_id=t.owner_id AND e.task_id=t.id JOIN training_answer a ON a.owner_id=e.owner_id AND a.session_id=e.session_id AND a.question_id=e.question_id AND a.id=e.answer_id JOIN training_question q ON q.owner_id=a.owner_id AND q.session_id=a.session_id AND q.id=a.question_id JOIN training_session s ON s.owner_id=a.owner_id AND s.id=a.session_id JOIN ai_evaluation_access g ON g.owner_id=a.owner_id AND g.session_id=a.session_id AND g.question_id=a.question_id AND g.answer_id=a.id AND g.early_feedback IN (0,1) AND g.granted_at BETWEEN '1000-01-01 00:00:00.000000' AND '9999-12-31 23:59:59.999999' WHERE t.owner_id=#{owner} AND t.purpose='ANSWER_EVALUATION' AND t.status='SUCCEEDED' AND s.status IN ('RUNNING','PAUSED','ENDED') AND a.version_number BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND ((s.mode='LEARNING' AND a.answer_condition='LEARNING') OR (s.mode IN ('FOCUSED','MOCK') AND a.answer_condition IN ('BEFORE_ASSISTANCE','ASSISTED'))) AND a.assistance_event_sequence BETWEEN 0 AND 2000 AND (a.answer_condition<>'ASSISTED' OR a.assistance_event_sequence>0) AND (a.answer_condition<>'BEFORE_ASSISTANCE' OR a.assistance_event_sequence=0) AND JSON_TYPE(s.config_json)='OBJECT' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.config_json,'$.feedbackTiming'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.config_json,'$.feedbackTiming')) IN ('AFTER_ANSWER','AFTER_SESSION') AND (s.status='ENDED' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.config_json,'$.feedbackTiming'))='AFTER_ANSWER' OR g.early_feedback=1) AND t.id < #{afterId} ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
